issues.problem: A flat white cursor/selection ring floats over the facade. It is a stock-looking UI element that doesn't share the soft painted, beveled look of the world.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 1 (one cohesive art direction; no stock widgets), reference-band minor flaw
issues.fix: Restyle the cursor as a soft tinted ring (warm cream, 2 px stroke, 40% inner fill) with a small drop shadow on the facade, or hide it in beauty captures

issues.problem: The only interactive cue is a tiny ring about 10 px wide. At 720p JPEG it disappears among the white window frames, so the point of interaction doesn't read.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 2 (instant read at 720p), anchor 9.5
issues.fix: Make the cursor at least 24 px at 720p and give it a contrasting tint that no facade element uses

issues.problem: The lime-green and acid-yellow facades are near full saturation and sit next to each other. They push toward neon against the muted teal sky.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 3 (controlled saturation; no neon), minor flaw
issues.fix: Lower the saturation of the lime and yellow facade tints by about 10–12% and shift the lime roughly 8° toward teal

issues.problem: The one pure-red facade is a hot accent. It pulls harder than every other hue in the row.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 3, reference-band minor flaw (one hot accent)
issues.fix: Shift the red toward the roof terracotta (around #C8503E) so it harmonises with the tiles

issues.problem: The overcast key light hits every facade almost equally, so the curved frontages look flat. There is little modelling from a directional key.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 4 (clear key light giving form), minor flaw
issues.fix: Add a soft upper-left key at about 35° elevation that gives around 15% luminance falloff across each curved facade

issues.problem: The contact shadow where the buildings meet the quay is weak, so the row doesn't sit on the quay as firmly as it should.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 4 (pieces lift off through shadow), minor flaw
issues.fix: Add a tinted ambient-occlusion band (deep teal, 30% opacity, about 12 px) along the base of the facades

issues.problem: The window frames are crisp square insets. Their sharp corners are the one hard-edged element among the rounded, curved facades.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 5 (every edge beveled or rounded), minor flaw
issues.fix: Give the window frames a 1–2 px bevel radius and a soft inner shadow

issues.problem: The row is an evenly weighted frieze with no single focal point. Every house has the same size, value and spacing, so the eye scans left to right with nothing to land on. That is noticeable at a glance next to the board's island frame, which gathers its mass to a clear focus.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 6 ★ (one obvious focal point), band 8.0–8.9
issues.fix: Frame the shot on the central archway and red house: make the flanking houses about 20% darker and less saturated toward the frame edges, or drop the camera to a three-quarter angle so the row recedes toward a focus

issues.problem: A flat, frontal, orthographic-feeling view leaves about 40% of the frame as empty sky. The subject is squeezed into a horizontal band and cut off at both side edges, which reads as dead space rather than breathing room.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 7 (breathing room, no dead space), band 8.0–8.9
issues.fix: Tilt the camera down about 10° and move it in so the rooftops sit near the upper third and the sky takes about 25% of the frame. Add some depth with a receding angle

issues.region: blue and teal facades, right half
issues.problem: The brick tile pattern repeats visibly at the same scale and phase on neighbouring houses.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 10 (no visible tiling), minor flaw
issues.fix: Randomise the brick UV offset per building and add a low-frequency tint variation mask (±5% value)

issues.problem: The quay stone texture looks soft and slightly blurry compared with the crisp facades.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 10 (no blurry art), minor flaw
issues.fix: Double the quay texture's texel density, or add a detail-normal map at 4x tiling

issues.problem: The flat frieze framing reads more like an editor viewport than a composed hero shot, which slightly undercuts the premium impression.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 15 ★ (stranger believes premium indie), minor flaw
issues.fix: Use a composed three-quarter camera with depth-of-field falloff for the showcase frame

issues.problem: The unstyled cursor ring breaks the illusion of a finished product.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 15 ★, minor flaw
issues.fix: Restyle or hide the cursor as in CAL-R1-01

issues.region: roof ridge lines and chimney tops, y 300–340
issues.problem: The thin roof edges and chimneys show slight stair-step aliasing at 1280x720.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 18 (no aliasing), minor flaw
issues.fix: Enable MSAA 4x or TAA with sharpening, or thicken the roof outline to at least 1.5 px

issues.problem: The grey stone quay and flat water look plainer and less hand-painted than the rich tiled facades above them, so the frame's material voice is a little uneven.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 1 (one cohesive handcrafted world), reference-band minor flaw
issues.fix: Warm the quay stone toward the roof terracotta (about +8% hue shift and +10% saturation) and add the same hand-drawn brick bevel pattern the facades use

issues.problem: The lime and yellow-green facades push toward neon saturation next to the calmer teal and blue houses.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 3 (controlled saturation; ≤5 column 'neon'), minor flaw
issues.fix: Cut saturation on the lime and yellow-green facade tiles by about 12% and pull their hue 5° toward the ochre yellow

issues.region: seagulls upper-centre, window frames across the row
issues.problem: The gulls and window frames sit close to pure white instead of a tinted off-white.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 3 (no pure black or white)
issues.fix: Tint the whites to a warm cream (e.g. #F4EFE4) and give the gulls a cool shadow side

issues.problem: The overcast ambient light has no clearly readable key direction, so the facades light up almost evenly from left to right.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 4 (clear key light), minor flaw
issues.fix: Add a soft directional key from upper-left at about 30% over ambient so side faces darken by one value step

issues.region: base of facades at the quay line (y≈560–590)
issues.problem: Contact shadow where the buildings meet the quay is faint, so the row does not lift or ground itself strongly.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 4 (pieces lift off through rim plus blob shadow)
issues.fix: Add a 12–16 px soft AO band at the facade base at 35% opacity, tinted teal-grey

issues.problem: The facades bulge softly, but the roof eaves and square window frames still have crisp, unbevelled box edges.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 5 (every edge beveled or rounded)
issues.fix: Add a 1–2 px bevel or rounded profile to the eave lips and window-frame corners

issues.problem: The equal-weight row of houses gives no single dominant focal point. The red house and the archway only weakly pull the eye.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 6 (one obvious focal point), minor flaw
issues.fix: Raise the red house or the archway about 10% in value contrast, or add a warm lit window there as the anchor

issues.problem: The scattered white gulls compete with the facades for attention because they are the brightest values in the frame.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 6 (eye moves action → state → context)
issues.fix: Drop gull brightness by about 10% and cluster them nearer the archway so they guide the eye to the focus

issues.problem: The large flat sky above the rooftops is close to dead space and pushes the subject into a low horizontal band.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 7 (breathing room without dead space)
issues.fix: Tilt the camera down about 5–8% or add a soft cloud gradient so the sky carries some value interest

issues.region: left and right edges at roof height
issues.problem: The end houses are cut exactly at the frame edges, which reads as a slight tangent even though the crop is deliberate.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 7 (no awkward tangents)
issues.fix: Shift the framing so each edge cuts mid-house (at least 40 px past a roof break)

issues.problem: The brick-tile texture repeats in a very even grid across all facades, with little per-tile variation.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 10 (no visible tiling; subtle grain)
issues.fix: Add ±6% per-brick value jitter and a low-frequency grime mask to break up the repeat

issues.problem: The water is a nearly flat teal band with only faint reflections, so it reads less as a material than the facades do.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 10 (materials read)
issues.fix: Add a subtle ripple normal and a 20% reflection of the facade colours with vertical smear

issues.problem: The flat, frontal elevation staging is slightly less inviting than the board's angled dioramas.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 15 (premium indie gut check), minor flaw
issues.fix: Give the camera a 10–15° yaw and slight elevation to add depth to the row

issues.region: centre archway, stair railings and bunting (x≈715–770, y≈460–600)
issues.problem: The thin railings and bunting line show slight stair-step aliasing.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 18 (no aliasing)
issues.fix: Enable MSAA 4x or TAA, or thicken the railing geometry to at least 2 px at 720p

issues.problem: The timer numeral is a flat white glyph with a thin dark outline. It lacks the sculpted clay volume of the cards, the 'or' blob and the room-code plate, so it reads as a UI overlay rather than part of the clay world.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 1: one cohesive handcrafted world; §4.1 minor flaw −0.1
issues.fix: Render the timer on a small clay token (same material and bevel as the answer cards, ~64 px) with a soft 4 px tinted drop shadow

issues.problem: The prompt 'The best way to stay young forever' is only ~24 px cap-to-baseline at 720p. It is noticeably smaller than the answer text, so the question takes a second look at stream quality.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 2: state and critical text clear within 1 s; §4.1 minor −0.2
issues.fix: Scale the prompt up ~25% (to ~30 px at 720p) and add a 2 px dark-blue outline for stream compression

issues.problem: The instruction 'Pick your favorite…' is set in near-pure white. Everything else in the frame is tinted: lavender-white cards, warm yellow prompt, blue shadows.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 3: no pure black or white; §4.1 minor −0.2
issues.fix: Tint the instruction text to the card lavender-white (~#EEF0FF) or a pale blue

issues.problem: The cyan glow at the tunnel's vanishing point is hotter than the rest of the soft ambient lighting and pulls a little light away from the cards.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 4: deliberate, controlled lighting; §4.1 one hot accent −0.2
issues.fix: Lower the centre glow intensity ~30% and shift it toward the mid-blue so it frames the cards rather than competing with them

issues.problem: The bright white bold instruction line has nearly the same visual weight as the prompt. The eye goes back and forth between top and bottom text before settling on the cards.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 6: eye moves action → state → context; §4.1 minor −0.2
issues.fix: Drop the instruction line to ~80% of its size and 85% opacity so it sits clearly below the cards in the hierarchy

issues.problem: The 'or' blob touches the inner edges of both cards, which creates a tangent.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 7: no awkward tangents; §4.1 tangent −0.1
issues.fix: Widen the gap between the cards by ~24 px so the 'or' blob floats with 8–10 px clearance on each side

issues.problem: Below the instruction line the lower band is empty tunnel and slightly bottom-light. The cards sit a touch high for the space.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 7: breathing room without dead space; §4.1 minor −0.2
issues.fix: Shift the cards and the instruction line down ~20 px so the vertical margins balance

issues.problem: There is a stray double space between 'Pick' and 'your'.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 8 typographic craft; §4.1 stray double space −0.1
issues.fix: Collapse it to a single space in the string

issues.problem: 'CHANGE YOUR NAME TO' fills almost the full card width and leaves 'TURBO' as a short second line, which gives the two cards unequal text measure and margins.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 8: no widows, consistent scale; §4.1 minor −0.2
issues.fix: Balance the line breaks (e.g. 'CHANGE YOUR / NAME TO "TURBO"') and keep ≥ 32 px inner padding on both cards

issues.problem: The room-code plate has a near-black hard shadow and dark slab. It is heavier and harsher than the soft, tinted card shadows elsewhere.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 9: consistent shadows across components; §4.1 minor −0.2
issues.fix: Change the plate colour to a deep navy (~#1C2350) and soften its shadow to a 6 px blur with a blue tint

issues.region: background tunnel, left and right edges
issues.problem: The clay tunnel folds at the frame edges look slightly smeared and low-detail compared with the crisp thumb-print texture on the cards.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 10: materials read with subtle grain; §4.1 one soft texture −0.2
issues.fix: Add a fine clay-grain normal detail to the tunnel material, or reduce its depth-of-field blur by ~30%

issues.problem: The white 'or' on the pale cyan blob has low contrast, around 2:1.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 11: contrast ≥ 4.5:1 in principle; §4.1 minor −0.2
issues.fix: Set 'or' in deep navy, or darken the blob to mid-teal so contrast is ≥ 4.5:1

issues.problem: The two options can be told apart only by left/right position. Players choosing on their devices get no matching glyph or colour key.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 11: colour + glyph identity; §4.1 minor −0.1
issues.fix: Add a small A/B or shape glyph badge (~28 px) to each card's top tab that matches the device buttons

issues.problem: The flat timer numeral is the one element that looks less crafted than the rest of this otherwise premium frame.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 15 premium gut check; §4.1 minor −0.1
issues.fix: Give the timer the same clay-token treatment as CAL-R1-01

issues.problem: The join URL above the room code is only ~13 px tall at 720p, so it is hard to read at stream quality.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 17: room code/join info legible; §4.1 small label −0.2
issues.fix: Increase the URL to ≥ 18 px at 720p and give it a 2 px dark outline

issues.problem: The timer '07' has no ring, label or urgency cue. It reads as a bare number, so a viewer can't be sure it is a countdown.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 17: timer is clear; §4.1 minor −0.2
issues.fix: Add a depleting radial ring around the number, turning warm amber below 5 s

issues.problem: There is faint banding in the gradient of the bright cyan centre glow.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 18: no banding; §4.1 minor −0.2
issues.fix: Add 1–2% blue-noise dither to the glow and render it in a 16-bit buffer before tone mapping

issues.problem: The prompt and instruction lines are flat outlined slab/bold type sitting on top of the clay world. They are the only elements that don't look sculpted or handcrafted, so they read a little like an overlay.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 1 (one cohesive handcrafted art direction), reference-band minor flaw 0.2
issues.fix: Give both lines a clay-plate backing (the same material as the URTX plaque, 12px radius, soft tinted drop shadow), or set them in the same hand-drawn face as the cards.

issues.problem: The prompt (the context for the choice) is only about 24px high at 720p, much smaller than the card text, so at stream quality it is the weakest line to read.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 2 (critical text instantly readable at 720p), minor 0.2
issues.fix: Scale the prompt to about 32px at 720p (48px at 1080p) and keep the yellow fill with its 3px dark outline.

issues.problem: The tunnel is close to one saturated electric blue, so the palette leans towards a single hot hue with little warm counterpoint.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 3 (harmonised, saturation-controlled party palette), minor 0.2
issues.fix: Lower the tunnel saturation by about 10–15% and add a warmer tint in the shadow folds (for example a violet-navy instead of pure blue).

issues.problem: The instruction text looks like pure #FFFFFF, which is harsher than the off-white card clay next to it.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 3 (no pure black or white), minor 0.1
issues.fix: Tint the text to a warm off-white around #FFF6E8 to match the card clay.

issues.problem: The cards are lit flat and evenly and cast almost no shadow onto the tunnel, so they lift off the background less than the central glow suggests they should.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 4 (pieces lift off through key light plus shadow), minor 0.2
issues.fix: Add a soft tinted contact shadow under each card (offset 8px down, 24px blur, navy at 40%) and a faint rim light along the edge facing the glow.

issues.problem: The large bright-white timer pulls the eye away from the two cards, so there is a small competition for focus.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 6 (one obvious focal point), minor 0.2
issues.fix: Drop the timer to 80% opacity and about 0.8× scale until the last 5 s, then pulse it.

issues.region: center, between the cards and the 'or' drop
issues.problem: The 'or' drop almost touches the inner edges of both cards, making tight near-tangents, and the right card sits slightly higher than the left.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 7 (breathing room, no awkward tangents), minor 0.2
issues.fix: Widen the gap between the cards by about 24px and align both card centres on the same y.

issues.problem: There is a stray double space in 'Pick  your'.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 8 (typographic craft; stray double space), minor 0.1
issues.fix: Collapse it to a single space: 'Pick your favorite on your device now!'

issues.problem: '"TURBO"' wraps alone onto a short second line, leaving a near-widow and a lopsided text block.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 8 (no widows), minor 0.2
issues.fix: Balance the line breaks (text-wrap: balance) so the text reads 'CHANGE YOUR NAME / TO "TURBO"'.

issues.problem: Four different display faces appear in one frame (rounded timer, yellow slab prompt, hand-lettered cards, bold serif instruction), which weakens the type system slightly.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 8 (restricted, deliberate family set), minor 0.1
issues.fix: Limit the frame to two families: hand-lettered for content, and one rounded bold for the prompt, instruction and timer.

issues.problem: The timer floats bare, while the room code sits on a crafted plaque, so the HUD components are inconsistent.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 9 (consistent component treatment), minor 0.2
issues.fix: Put the timer on a matching clay plaque or ring (same material and shadow as the URTX plate, 56px circle).

issues.problem: The small 'or' label is dark blue on a teal-blue drop, which is low contrast (well under 4.5:1).
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 11 (contrast ≥ 4.5:1 in principle), minor 0.2
issues.fix: Set the 'or' text in the off-white #FFF6E8 with a 2px navy outline, or darken the drop to navy with off-white text.

issues.problem: The plain white instruction line is the one element that feels like template UI and not crafted, which slightly undercuts the premium impression.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 15 (believably premium throughout), minor 0.2
issues.fix: Set the instruction on a paper or clay ribbon with a soft shadow, as in CAL-R1-01.

issues.problem: The room code is legible, but the timer is a bare number with no ring or label, so it takes a moment for a viewer to read it as a countdown.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 17 (timer clear at a glance), minor 0.2
issues.fix: Add a depleting radial ring (4px stroke) around the timer and colour-shift it at ≤5 s.

issues.problem: The dark outline on the yellow prompt shows slight stair-stepping on the curved letterforms.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 18 (no aliasing), minor 0.1
issues.fix: Render the outline with SDF text or at 2× and downsample, instead of a pixel-offset stroke.

issues.problem: The board, pieces, die and background all use default untextured grey and flat-colour engine materials. The HUD is unstyled browser text and the buttons are stock controls. There is no art direction, and the frame looks nothing like the board's handcrafted worlds.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 1 ≤5: 'default grey three.js materials, stock widgets'; §4.1 anchor 5
issues.fix: Replace MeshStandard grey materials with one art-directed kit: a clay-look PBR for the pieces (roughness 0.8, subsurface tint), a wood-grain mat texture, and a painted room backdrop. Restyle the HUD as paper-card panels in the same palette.

issues.problem: The turn, scores and room code are about 14 px black serif text crammed into the top-left corner. The turn does not stand out and has no player-colour cue, so at 720p JPEG you have to squint to read it.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 2: state clear within 1 s, critical text ≥22 px at 1080p
issues.fix: Add a turn banner at the top centre, ≥32 px, filled with Player 2's identity colour. Put the scores in per-player plates at 24 px with tabular figures, placed next to each player's corner.

issues.region: pieces in all four corners, background
issues.problem: The pieces are fully saturated primary red, green, blue and yellow on neutral #808080 grey. The shadows are grey, and the palette has no harmony.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 3 ≤5: 'off-palette, grey shadows, neon'
issues.fix: Pick a harmonised palette of 4 muted identity hues (for example terracotta, sage, dusk-blue and mustard at about 55–65% saturation). Tint the shadows toward warm violet, and replace the #808080 backdrop with a warm room tone.

issues.problem: The lighting is flat ambient and directional with no cast or contact shadows, so the pieces don't lift off the board. The frame has no mood and no mode identity.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 4 ≤5: 'flat or harsh lighting'
issues.fix: Add an upper-left warm key light with soft shadow maps (PCF soft, radius 4), blob contact shadows under each piece, a cool rim light, and a warm hemisphere fill.

issues.problem: The grey cube has razor-sharp edges, the board is a thin sharp-edged plane, and the cylinders have hard rims.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 5 ≤5: 'sharp boxes'
issues.fix: Use RoundedBoxGeometry for the die (radius 0.12), bevel the cylinder rims by 0.08, and give the board a thick rounded wooden frame.

issues.problem: Nothing is the focal point: the four equally saturated piece clusters compete with each other, the active player isn't highlighted, and the call to action (Roll) is a tiny button in the bottom-right corner.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 6 ≤5: 'everything shouts; unclear call to action'
issues.fix: Highlight the active player's pieces with a glow ring and desaturate the others. Make Roll a primary button of at least 64 px height at bottom centre, in the active player's colour.

issues.problem: The board floats in empty flat grey space. The top quarter is dead space, and the HUD and buttons are pushed into the corners with no framing.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 7 ≤5: 'dead space'
issues.fix: Lower the camera FOV to about 35°, tilt it so the mat fills about 75% of the frame height, and fill the surroundings with a table and room environment.

issues.problem: The HUD uses the browser-default serif font (Times) and the buttons use the default sans-serif. There's no size hierarchy, and the numbers aren't tabular.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 8 ≤5: 'fallback fonts'
issues.fix: Load a rounded display font for headings and a humanist sans for body text. Use a scale of 32/24/18 px and font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums for the scores.

issues.problem: 'Roll' and 'End turn' are unstyled default HTML buttons with 1 px borders and no radius, spacing system or states.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 9 ≤5: 'default controls'
issues.fix: Style the buttons with a 16 px radius, 12×24 px padding, a soft tinted drop shadow and hover/press states (translateY 2px). Space them 8 px apart on a 4-pt grid.

issues.problem: The board is flat light grey with 1 px grid lines and no material read. The background is a flat grey fill.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 10 ≤5: no materials
issues.fix: Apply a wood or felt texture with subtle grain (normal map at 0.3 strength) and inlaid, painted tile borders, and add a textured tabletop underneath.

issues.region: red and green pieces, top corners
issues.problem: Players are identified by colour alone. Red and green are indistinguishable under deuteranopia or protanopia simulation, and there are no glyphs.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 11 ≤5: 'distinguishable only by red vs green'
issues.fix: Give each player a unique glyph on the piece tops and HUD plates (circle, square, triangle, star), and choose hues that stay distinct under a CVD simulation.

issues.problem: At a glance this reads as an unfinished engine prototype or tech demo, not a premium indie game.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 15 ≤5: 'looks like a prototype'
issues.fix: Fix CAL-R1-01 through CAL-R1-10: one art direction, custom lighting, materials, typography and styled UI.

issues.problem: The room code is a tiny unstyled line of text with no emphasis, and there is no audience or timer state, so viewers can't find the code quickly.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 17: room code legible at a glance
issues.fix: Show the room code in a dedicated pill at the top right, ≥28 px monospace, with a 'Join at …' label in the audience accent colour.

issues.problem: The 1 px grid lines and the cylinder and cube silhouettes show visible aliasing and stair-stepping, and there's no anti-aliasing.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 18: no aliasing
issues.fix: Enable antialias: true or an FXAA/SMAA pass, and draw the grid as texture lines with mipmapping instead of line geometry.

issues.problem: There is no art direction. The frame has a default grey three.js background, an untextured light-grey grid plane, primary-coloured Lambert cylinders, a grey placeholder cube and sphere, a Times New Roman overlay and stock HTML buttons. Nothing reads as one handcrafted world.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 1 ≤5: default grey three.js materials, stock widgets; §4.1 working-prototype band
issues.fix: Build one clay/wood/paper world: a wood-grain mat with a paper board inlay, clay pawns with bevels and warm tinted shadows, a room backdrop instead of #808080, and themed UI components in place of the browser controls.

issues.problem: Turn, scores and room code sit in about 15 px black serif text in the corner. At stream quality you have to squint to read them, and nothing ties 'Player 2's turn' to a colour on the board.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 2: turn/state/scores clear within 1 s; critical text ≥22 px at 1080p
issues.fix: Add a HUD bar with per-player score chips in the identity colours and glyphs. Show the active player in a 32 px+ rounded display font with a highlight ring on that player's pawns.

issues.region: pawns in all four corners; background
issues.problem: The pawns use pure primary red, green, blue and yellow at full saturation. The background is neutral grey, the shadows are grey or absent, and the text is pure black.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 3 ≤5: off-palette, grey shadows, neon/primary colours
issues.fix: Swap to a harmonised warm palette: muted terracotta, sage, dusty blue and mustard. Tint the shadows toward warm purple and replace #000 text with a dark warm brown.

issues.problem: The lighting is flat and ambient-heavy, with no readable key direction. There are no cast or blob shadows, so the pawns do not lift off the board. The cube faces are the only shading cue.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 4 ≤5: flat or harsh lighting
issues.fix: Add an upper-left warm directional key with soft shadows, a cool fill, and a rim light plus a blob shadow under every pawn.

issues.problem: The cylinders have hard, unbeveled rims, the centre cube is a sharp-edged box and the board is a knife-thin plane with square corners.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 5 ≤5: sharp boxes
issues.fix: Bevel the pawn rims (radius about 15% of height), use a rounded-corner die with pips, and give the board a thick rounded wooden edge.

issues.problem: There is no focal point. The four equal-weight pawn clusters in the corners pull the eye outward, the grey die and ball sit unexplained in the centre, and the tiny Roll/End turn buttons are hidden bottom-right. The call to action is unclear.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 6 ≤5: unclear call to action
issues.fix: Highlight the active player's pawns, put a large primary 'Roll' button next to the die, and dim the inactive players.

issues.problem: The top quarter is dead flat grey. The board bottom edge sits almost on the frame edge, the corner pawns crowd the board edges and the buttons touch the frame corner.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 7 ≤5: dead space, awkward tangents
issues.fix: Lower the camera pitch about 10°, centre the mat with about 8% margin on all sides, and fill the backdrop with a room or table surface.

issues.problem: The text uses the browser-default serif (Times) and a default sans on the buttons, all at one size with no hierarchy and no tabular numbers.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 8 ≤5: fallback fonts, random sizes
issues.fix: Use a rounded display face for headings and a humanist sans for body text, on a clear scale (32/22/16), with tabular numbers for the scores.

issues.problem: The Roll and End turn buttons are unstyled browser defaults: tiny, jammed against the corner, with no radius, shadow or state styling.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 9 ≤5: default controls
issues.fix: Make themed pill buttons at least 48 px tall with 12 px radius, a soft tinted shadow, hover and pressed states, and 16 px spacing from the frame edge.

issues.problem: The board is a flat untextured grey plane with thin line grid. No material reads anywhere: no wood, felt or paper.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 10: materials read; ≤5 blurry/absent board art
issues.fix: Apply a subtle wood-grain or felt texture with a painted paper grid and printed track art.

issues.problem: Players are identified by hue alone, and the palette includes pure red against pure green. Pawns have no glyphs or shape differences, so they fail under deuteranopia.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 11 ≤5: players distinguishable only by red vs green
issues.fix: Give each player a unique glyph (star, moon, leaf, drop) embossed on the pawns and repeated in the HUD, and choose hues that separate in luminance.

issues.problem: The frame reads immediately as an engine test scene or template prototype, not a premium indie game.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 15 ≤5: looks like a prototype
issues.fix: Resolve items 1, 3, 4, 8 and 9 together: a complete art pass on the environment, materials, lighting and UI.

issues.problem: The room code is a tiny unstyled line of text with no emphasis, and there is no audience state. A viewer cannot spot the code at a glance.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 17: room code legible; audience UI clear at a glance
issues.fix: Put the room code in a dedicated 28 px+ badge with a join URL, in a stream-safe corner with a contrasting plate.

issues.problem: The 1 px grid lines and pawn edges alias and stair-step, most visibly on the receding lines. The cube and sphere are untextured placeholder primitives.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 18: no aliasing; visible artefacts
issues.fix: Enable MSAA 4x or FXAA, draw the grid as a texture with mipmaps rather than line primitives, and replace the placeholder primitives with finished assets.

issues.region: background band, x 300-1200, y 200-290 (chain-link fence, parked cars, grey tower)
issues.problem: The chain-link fence, parked cars and pale tower are more literal and less stylised than the faceted trees and flat-shaded ground, so the world's hand-made look slips a little in the background.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 1: every element reads as one cohesive art direction
issues.fix: Simplify the fence to chunky flat posts with a single alpha-card mesh at 50% opacity, and give the cars and tower the same faceted low-poly treatment and warm ochre tint as the foreground.

issues.problem: The main character takes up only about 120 px of height, and the palm and dry grass behind them are similar in value, so at 720p JPEG the subject separates only by its red cap.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 2 / §4.1 note: subject reads instantly at 720p
issues.fix: Move the camera about 15% closer or lower the FOV by 5°, and lighten the log top by +8% value so the character's silhouette stands out against it.

issues.region: log top right of character, x 705-770, y 405-440
issues.problem: The squirrel, the secondary point of interest, is a small orange shape that is barely visible against the brown log and bark.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 2: state clear within 1 s
issues.fix: Give the squirrel a 1 px lighter rim on its tail, or raise its saturation by about 10%, so it stands out from the log colour.

issues.region: lower-left and bottom-centre foreground haze, x 0-500, y 450-720
issues.problem: The foreground haze turns the shadowed areas a desaturated neutral grey instead of the tinted blue-teal shadow used elsewhere.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 3: tinted shadows, no grey shadows
issues.fix: Tint the fog colour toward the sky teal (about +15° hue toward teal, +10% saturation), or cut the near-fog density by 30%.

issues.region: bottom-left quadrant and near log end, x 0-450, y 480-720
issues.problem: The near-camera haze flattens the foreground contrast, so the lower-left looks washed out compared with the crisp sunlit midground.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 4: clear key light, no flat lighting
issues.fix: Start the depth fog 3-4 m further from the camera so the foreground keeps full sun and shadow contrast.

issues.problem: The character's contact shadow is a hard cast shadow that falls to the lower-right, with no soft ambient contact under the feet, so they lift off the log only a little.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 4: pieces lift off the surface through rim light plus contact shadow
issues.fix: Add a soft contact blob under the feet at about 25% opacity with a 12 px blur, and a faint warm rim on the upper-left of the cap.

issues.region: bare branches, x 0-120 y 400-470 and x 320-380 y 260-330
issues.problem: The thin, bare twig branches are spindly and jagged next to the chunky faceted canopy and trunks.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 5: chunky toy silhouettes, no spindly shapes
issues.fix: Thicken the twig meshes to at least 2x their current width and cut the branch count by about 40%, or replace them with chunky 3-facet stubs.

issues.problem: The leaf-cluster facets have hard polygonal corners that read as sharp rather than soft on a second look.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 5: edges beveled or rounded
issues.fix: Smooth the canopy normals by about 30° or add one bevel subdivision so the cluster outlines read rounder.

issues.region: right foreground dry grass, x 860-1280, y 450-720
issues.problem: The bright, high-contrast dry grass and white pebbles in the lower right compete with the character for attention.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 6: one obvious focal point
issues.fix: Lower the value of the right foreground grass by about 10% and shrink or reduce the white pebble scatter by 50% so the log and character stay dominant.

issues.region: bottom-left, second log end at x 330-440, y 560-720
issues.problem: The second log segment runs straight into the bottom frame edge and nearly touches the main log, which creates an awkward tangent.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 7: no awkward tangents
issues.fix: Yaw the camera about 3° to the right, or move the log about 60 px left, so the two log ends separate clearly or the near log leaves the frame fully.

issues.problem: The dense canopy presses against the top edge and leaves almost no sky, so the frame feels a little heavy at the top.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 7: breathing room
issues.fix: Tilt the camera about 2° down, or thin the nearest canopy by one cluster, to open a sky gap of about 40 px.

issues.problem: The stone-like blotch pattern on the log's top repeats at a visibly regular interval along its length.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 10: no visible tiling
issues.fix: Randomise the UV offset per segment, or blend in a second noise mask at 0.37x scale, to break up the repeat.

issues.region: whole frame, foreground haze and background props
issues.problem: The washed-out foreground and the more literal background props make it read slightly below the crispest board frames.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 15: premium indie gut check
issues.fix: Apply the fog and background-stylisation fixes from CAL-R1-01 and CAL-R1-04.

issues.problem: The fine fence mesh shows moiré and aliasing at this distance.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 18: no aliasing shimmer
issues.fix: Enable alpha-to-coverage with mip-biased fence alpha (bias -0.5), or fade the fence to a flat translucent card beyond 20 m.

issues.region: thin grass blades, x 820-1100, y 350-470 and bottom-right
issues.problem: The thin grass blades show stair-step aliasing on their edges.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 18: no aliasing
issues.fix: Enable MSAA 4x or TAA for the foliage pass, or widen the blades to at least 2 px on screen.

issues.region: right-centre background (chain-link fence, parked cars, tower)
issues.problem: The fine chain-link fence and the parked vehicles read more literal and less hand-shaped than the chunky faceted trees and log, so the art direction wobbles a little in the background.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 1 (one cohesive handcrafted world), reference band minor flaw
issues.fix: Rebuild the fence as chunky posts with a 3–4 px stylised mesh texture, and simplify the cars to the same facet count as the foliage

issues.region: centre, character on log (~60 px tall)
issues.problem: The main character is small at 720p, and their dark torso sits on the log's cast shadow, so the subject takes a moment to separate from the scene.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 2 (subject reads instantly at 720p), reference band minor flaw
issues.fix: Pull the camera about 15% closer, or add a warm 1–2 px rim light on the character so their luminance separates from the shadowed log by at least 20%

issues.region: mid-ground tree trunks and canopy undersides
issues.problem: The distance haze pushes the trunks to a flat, desaturated blue-grey that feels close to neutral grey next to the warm ochre ground.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 3 (tinted shadows, no grey), reference band minor flaw
issues.fix: Tint the fog colour toward the sky teal (e.g. +8% saturation, hue about 200°) instead of neutral grey-blue

issues.problem: The heavy foreground haze and shade flatten the lower-left plants, which lose the crisp sun and shadow contrast seen elsewhere.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 4 (clear key light, forms lift), reference band minor flaw
issues.fix: Lower foreground fog density by about 30%, or add a soft bounce fill so the near foliage keeps its form shading

issues.region: mid-left and right bare twig bushes
issues.problem: The bare-branch shrubs have thin, spindly, sharp-tipped silhouettes that break from the chunky toy forms of the trees and the log.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 5 (chunky toy silhouettes, no spindly shapes), reference band minor flaw
issues.fix: Thicken the twig geometry about 2x and round the tips, or replace the shrubs with chunky faceted bush clusters

issues.region: bottom-right 30% (bright grass and white rock chips)
issues.problem: The high-value dry grass and the scattered white chips at bottom-right pull the eye away from the character on the log.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 6 (one obvious focal point), reference band minor flaw
issues.fix: Darken the bottom-right foreground grass by about 15% and cut the white chip density by half

issues.problem: The distant tower is cut off by the top frame edge, which makes an awkward tangent.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 7 (no awkward tangents), reference band minor flaw
issues.fix: Tilt the camera down about 3°, or move the tower so it is either fully in frame or clearly hidden behind the canopy

issues.problem: The near end of the log meets the bottom frame edge at a hard diagonal, which adds a second tangent at the frame border.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 7 (breathing room, no tangents), reference band minor flaw
issues.fix: Shift the camera about 40 px right so the log enters the frame through the bottom edge rather than the corner

issues.problem: The blotchy cell pattern on the log's top reads more as a procedural stamp than as bark or wood grain.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 10 (materials read, subtle grain), reference band minor flaw
issues.fix: Replace the cell pattern with a lengthwise grain at about 50% contrast that follows the log's axis

issues.problem: The lower half is washed out by haze, which slightly dulls the premium punch compared with the board's crispest frames.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 15 (a stranger believes it is premium indie), reference band minor flaw
issues.fix: Add a light contrast curve (+5% on midtones) and reduce near-camera fog so foreground values reach full depth

issues.problem: The fine fence mesh shows faint moiré and aliasing at this resolution.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 18 (no aliasing shimmer), reference band minor flaw
issues.fix: Enable mipmapped alpha-to-coverage on the fence texture, or raise the mesh cell size so it stays above 4 px on screen

issues.problem: The lower-left water, rocks and castle base sink into a dark, low-contrast purple. At 720p JPEG q60 the forms there turn to mush, so the castle's footing reads more slowly than its lit upper half.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 2: subject reads within 1 s at stream quality; §4.1 reference-band minor flaw (0.2)
issues.fix: Lift the shadow floor in the bottom 30% by about 8–10% luminance and add a faint warm rim on the rock tops facing the key light, so the silhouettes stay separate after compression

issues.region: centre-left spires and bottom-edge rock shards
issues.problem: The needle-thin spires, flag poles and knife-edged rock shards are spindly and sharp next to the soft, rounded clouds and trees, so the form language is slightly split.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 5: chunky silhouettes with rounded edges; §4.1 minor flaw (0.2)
issues.fix: Widen the spire bases by about 15%, round the rock-shard tips with a 2–4 px equivalent bevel, and thicken the flag poles so they survive at 720p

issues.problem: The brightly rim-lit tree canopies in the bottom-right corner are nearly as bright as the castle facade and pull the eye away from the focal point.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 6: one obvious focal point; §4.1 minor flaw (0.1)
issues.fix: Knock the highlights on the bottom-right foreground trees down about 10% in value, or add a light vignette there, so the castle facade stays the brightest mass

issues.problem: The rock shard tips touch the bottom frame edge and make awkward tangents with it.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 7: no awkward tangents; §4.1 minor flaw (0.1)
issues.fix: Tilt the camera about 3% down, or crop so the shard tips either clear the bottom edge by 20 px or are cut decisively

issues.problem: The foreground trees crowd the bottom-right corner, leaving the bridge and gatehouse little breathing room compared with the open sky above.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 7: breathing room; §4.1 minor flaw (0.2)
issues.fix: Pull the foreground tree cluster about 60 px to the right or out of frame so the bridge's end reads clearly

issues.problem: The moat water is a soft, murky smear with little surface definition compared with the crisp stone and roof tiles, so it reads as blur rather than as a material.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 10: materials read, no blurry art; §4.1 minor flaw (0.1)
issues.fix: Add a subtle ripple normal (low amplitude, about 0.3) and a sharper sky-reflection highlight band on the water

issues.problem: The cliff rock and masonry under the castle have denser, more realistic texture detail than the soft, simplified tree canopies and clouds, so the stylisation is slightly uneven.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 1: one cohesive handcrafted world (reference band, minor flaw)
issues.fix: Simplify the cliff and stone normal and albedo detail by about 40% and widen the bevels, so the rock matches the chunky foliage shapes.

issues.problem: The brightly lit foreground tree tops at the bottom right are nearly as bright as the castle's lit face and pull the eye at a glance.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.1 item 2: subject reads instantly at 720p (minor flaw)
issues.fix: Darken the foreground canopy exposure by about 0.5 EV, or add a soft vignette of about 15% in the bottom-right corner.

issues.problem: The violet dusk wash pulls the tree greens so far toward the sky's lilac that foliage and sky hues blend together, which lowers hue separation.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 3: harmonised palette with controlled saturation (minor flaw)
issues.fix: Keep a trace of sage in the tree albedo (hue shift of about +15°) under the grade, so the canopy separates from the sky.

issues.problem: The shadowed foreground water and rocks fall into muddy, low-contrast purple-brown with no fill or rim light, so their forms flatten.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 4: forms lift through rim light (minor flaw)
issues.fix: Add a weak cool fill of about 10% intensity from the sky side, plus a faint rim on the foreground rocks.

issues.region: castle spires and foreground rock spikes, bottom-centre
issues.problem: The needle-thin spires, the sharp crenellations and the jagged rock spikes at the bottom edge are harsher than the rounded clouds and trees.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 5: rounded, chunky silhouettes (minor flaws)
issues.fix: Round the rock-spike tips with a bevel radius of about 8% of spike width and thicken the spires' base-to-tip taper.

issues.problem: The bridge piers read as thin, spindly verticals against the dark water.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 5: no spindly shapes (minor flaw)
issues.fix: Widen the piers by about 30% and add a soft chamfer.

issues.problem: The castle is the clear focal point, but the brightly lit foreground foliage is a secondary hotspot that competes with it.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 6: one obvious focal point (minor flaw)
issues.fix: Reduce the foreground canopy highlight intensity by about 25%.

issues.region: bottom edge, left and centre rocks
issues.problem: The foreground rocks are cropped awkwardly by the bottom frame edge and make tangents with it.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 7: no awkward tangents (minor flaw)
issues.fix: Tilt the camera up about 3°, or move the rocks so they either clear the edge or clearly overlap it.

issues.problem: The dark water at the bottom left is low-information dead space.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 7: no dead space (minor flaw)
issues.fix: Reframe about 5% to the right, or add lily pads and highlights to the water.

issues.problem: The moat reflections are murky and slightly smeared, so the water reads less clearly as a material than the stone and roof tiles do.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 10: materials read clearly (minor flaw)
issues.fix: Raise the water's specular and Fresnel by about 20% and sharpen the reflection roughness to about 0.15.

issues.problem: The frame is of premium quality overall; only the murky lower-left quadrant keeps it from being flawless.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 15: premium indie gut check (minor flaw)
issues.fix: Apply the fill-light and water fixes from CAL-R1-04 and CAL-R1-10.

issues.region: flag poles and smoke wisps above castle
issues.problem: The thin flag poles and chimney smoke strands show faint stair-stepping and aliasing.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 18: no aliasing (minor flaw)
issues.fix: Enable TAA or 4x MSAA for the thin geometry, or thicken the smoke strands to at least 2 px at 720p.

issues.problem: The dense small stairs, railings and window grids in the lower cluster merge into texture noise at 720p, so the base of the town reads less cleanly than the silhouette above it.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 2: subject reads within 1 s at 720p; reference band, minor flaw -0.1
issues.fix: Thin out the micro-detail on the lower tiers, or lower its contrast by about 15% so the roofs and walls stay the dominant read.

issues.region: centre, white tower and white facades
issues.problem: The lit white facades on the central tower come close to pure white and are the hottest value in the frame, a little outside the otherwise tinted palette.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 3: no pure black or white; minor flaw -0.2
issues.fix: Tint the white plaster toward a warm cream (about #EFE6D8) and cap its highlight luminance at about 92%.

issues.problem: The overcast fog light is soft and deliberate, but the key direction is weak, so the forms rely on local colour more than light to separate from each other.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 4: clear key light and lift off the ground; minor flaw -0.2
issues.fix: Add a soft upper-left key at about 20% intensity with a slightly warmer tint, so the rooftops pick up a gentle directional gradient.

issues.region: centre-right, dark bridge scaffold and railings
issues.problem: The thin dark metal scaffold under the bridge and the wire railings are spindly and hard-edged against the otherwise chunky, soft toy forms.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 5: chunky toy silhouettes, no spindly shapes; minor flaw -0.2
issues.fix: Thicken the scaffold posts by about 1.5x, round their caps, and lighten them from near-black to a tinted slate.

issues.problem: The main island's base and reflection sit tight against the bottom frame edge, which crowds the base while the upper-right sky holds a lot of empty space.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 7: breathing room, no awkward tangents; minor flaw -0.2
issues.fix: Tilt the camera down or raise the framing by about 40 px, so the waterline gets a margin of 8% or more above the bottom edge.

issues.problem: The square tile/brick pattern on the walls is very uniform, and a faint grid repeat is visible on the large white and green walls.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 10: no visible tiling, subtle grain; minor flaw -0.2
issues.fix: Add per-tile colour variation of about ±4% lightness and a low-frequency grime mask to break up the repeat.

issues.region: railings and balconies, centre and right island
issues.problem: The thin railing lines show slight stair-step aliasing at 1280x720.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 18: no aliasing; minor flaw -0.2
issues.fix: Turn on TAA/MSAA 4x, or fade thin geometry below 1.5 px screen width to an alpha-blended stand-in.

issues.region: centre, dark iron bridge/scaffold between towers
issues.problem: The thin black-iron gantry at centre is harder and more technical than the soft stucco and tile language around it, so it reads slightly off-style.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 1 (one cohesive handcrafted world), reference-band minor flaw
issues.fix: Tint the ironwork to a warm deep plum (~#4a3a48) and thicken its members by ~30% so it matches the chunky toy forms

issues.problem: The detached islet draws a second read that is close in weight to the main island, which slightly slows the 1 s subject read.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 2 / §4.1 'no game state: subject reads instantly'
issues.fix: Push the islet ~15% further into the fog (lower its contrast and saturation) so the main island owns the read

issues.problem: The tower's tiles are close to pure white and clip against the fog, sitting outside the otherwise muted, tinted palette.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 3 'no pure black or white'
issues.fix: Clamp the facade highlights to a warm cream (~#efe6d8) and add a 5% teal fog tint

issues.problem: The coral-red walls are the hottest accent in the frame and a little oversaturated next to the pastel teal and yellow.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 3 (controlled saturation), reference-band minor flaw
issues.fix: Lower the red wall saturation by ~8% toward a dusty coral

issues.problem: The overcast key is very diffuse: the direction of the light is weak and the cast shadows under roofs and balconies are faint, so the forms lift less than they could.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 4 (clear key light, pieces lift), reference-band minor flaw
issues.fix: Raise the key-to-fill ratio by ~20% from the upper-left and deepen the contact shadows under eaves with a tinted teal-violet

issues.problem: The water reflections and contact line are soft and low-contrast, so the islands sit a little flat on the sea.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 4 (lift and grounding), second-look flaw
issues.fix: Add a 10–15% darker ambient-occlusion band at the waterline

issues.region: railings along the lower quays and balconies
issues.problem: The thin railings and gantry are spindly next to the chunky rounded roofs and walls.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 5 'spindly shapes'
issues.fix: Thicken the railing posts and rails to about 1.5× and round their caps

issues.problem: The secondary islet splits focus slightly away from the central tower's focal point.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 6 (one obvious focal point)
issues.fix: Reduce the islet's contrast and value range by ~15% or crop it to partly leave the frame

issues.region: bottom edge below the main island
issues.problem: The main island's base and reflection sit only ~40 px above the bottom edge, while there is generous sky above, so the frame is tight at the bottom.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 7 (breathing room)
issues.fix: Tilt the camera down ~3° or raise the framing so the base clears the bottom edge by ≥80 px

issues.region: tower facade and large wall planes
issues.problem: On the big flat walls the square tile texture repeats regularly and can be picked out on a second look.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 10 'no visible tiling'
issues.fix: Add per-tile value jitter of ±4% and a low-frequency grime or wash mask to break up the repeat

issues.problem: The frame is of premium quality, but its flat overcast light makes it slightly less striking than the board's golden-hour frames.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 15, reference-band minor flaw
issues.fix: Add a subtle warm rim of sun breaking through the fog on the upper-left of the tower

issues.problem: The thin dark railing lines show slight stair-step aliasing at 720p.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 18 'no aliasing shimmer'
issues.fix: Enable TAA/MSAA 4× or thicken the lines past 1.5 px screen width

issues.problem: The smooth fog gradient shows faint banding steps.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 18 'no banding'
issues.fix: Add ~1/255 blue-noise dither to the sky and fog pass

issues.problem: The two characters and campfire, which are the subject, fill only about 3% of the frame. At 720p JPEG the navy character's silhouette merges into the dirt shadow, so you have to look twice to see who is there.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 2: subject reads instantly at 720p (frames with no game state)
issues.fix: Push the camera in about 15% on the campfire, or add a 1 px lighter rim/outline on character sprites so they separate from the ground at quality 60

issues.problem: The character's dark navy cloak is close to black and is the lowest-value, least warm patch in an otherwise disciplined autumn palette
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 3: no pure black; controlled, harmonised palette
issues.fix: Lift the cloak's darkest shade to a warm-tinted indigo (about 15% more value, hue shifted 10° toward violet)

issues.problem: Light is soft ambient with weak directional cues. The characters barely lift off the ground, and the campfire casts no warm local light on the figures or the logs.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 4: pieces lift off the ground; clear key or deliberate equivalent
issues.fix: Add a warm orange radial falloff (radius about 80 px, 20% opacity) from the campfire onto the nearby ground and the characters' facing sides

issues.problem: The large, saturated orange cabin roof has similar visual weight to the red tree canopies and competes with the small campfire focal point
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 6: one obvious focal point
issues.fix: Lower the roof's saturation about 10%, or brighten the fire/smoke area so the campfire becomes the value peak

issues.problem: A large grey foreground rock is cut off by the bottom edge and takes up about 20% of the frame without adding to the scene
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 7: no dead space or awkward crops
issues.fix: Tilt the camera up or reframe about 60 px higher so the rock is a thin foreground sliver

issues.problem: A waterfall/structure fragment is sliced by the top edge, which creates a tangent
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 7: awkward tangents
issues.fix: Shift the framing so the fragment is either fully out of frame or clearly included

issues.problem: The cliff rock striation pattern repeats in near-identical horizontal dashes over large areas, which reads as slightly tiled
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 10: no visible tiling
issues.fix: Add a second striation variant and randomise the rotation/offset per cliff face

issues.region: thin yellow diagonal line from cabin through campfire to right edge (~y290-520)
issues.problem: A 1 px bright line crosses the scene diagonally and reads as a stray render line or rope artefact rather than a clear object. Stair-step aliasing is also visible along it.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 18: no aliasing or stray artefacts
issues.fix: Either give the line clear endpoints/posts and 2 px pixel-snapped width, or remove it

issues.problem: The two characters at the campfire are only about 50–60 px tall at 720p. The subject reads, but the figures' silhouettes and faces blur at stream quality.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 2: a frame with no game state is judged on how instantly its subject reads at 720p
issues.fix: Push the camera in about 15% on the campfire, or add a 1 px darker outline to the characters so they separate from the brown path

issues.region: mid-frame diagonal, left cabin to right fence
issues.problem: A thin, saturated yellow light/rope line runs across the frame. It is one hot accent that fights the otherwise controlled autumn palette.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.1 place: one hot accent costs 0.1
issues.fix: Drop the line's saturation about 30% and blend it at 50% opacity toward the grass hue

issues.problem: The characters' contact shadows are weak against the brown path, so they lift off the ground less clearly than the cabin and trees do.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 4: pieces lift off the board through rim light plus blob shadow (judged in principle)
issues.fix: Add a soft tinted blob shadow at 35% opacity under each character, and a faint warm rim from the fire

issues.problem: The rock cliff edges show harsh stair-stepped diagonals that read sharper than the rounded tree and bush silhouettes.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 5: jagged silhouettes
issues.fix: Hand-clean the cliff-edge pixel runs into consistent 1:2 or 1:1 steps, or bevel the cliff rims by one pixel band of highlight

issues.problem: The saturated red-orange autumn trees next to the campfire carry as much visual weight as the focal campfire and pull the eye away from it.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 6: one obvious focal point
issues.fix: Lower the value/saturation of the upper-right red canopies about 10%, or add a warm glow radius around the fire to anchor focus

issues.region: bottom-centre rock and pond, bottom-left tree
issues.problem: The large grey boulder and teal pond are cut by the bottom edge, and the red tree crown at bottom-left is also cropped, so the lower 20% feels crowded.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 7: awkward tangents
issues.fix: Tilt the camera up about 5% so the boulder either sits fully in frame or is clearly cropped past its midpoint

issues.problem: The waterfall/cliff top forms a tangent with the top frame edge.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 7: awkward tangents
issues.fix: Shift the framing about 30 px so the waterfall top either clears the edge or is decisively cropped

issues.problem: The striated rock texture repeats in similar crack strokes across the large cliff areas and reads slightly patterned.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 10: no visible tiling
issues.fix: Break up the rock stripes with 2–3 variant crack stamps and a low-frequency value variation

issues.problem: The thin diagonal light line is rendered at native resolution over the chunky low-res pixel grid, which mixes pixel densities and makes the line look aliased.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 18: no aliasing
issues.fix: Render the line into the same low-res pixel buffer as the scene, or snap it to the art's pixel grid

issues.problem: The main character takes up only about 12% of the frame height, and the sky and sea behind them are similar in value, so the subject needs a second look at 720p stream quality.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 2: subject reads within 1 s at 720p; §4.1 minor flaw 0.2
issues.fix: Push the camera in about 15% on the character, or darken the sea and sky behind the head by about 8% value, so the silhouette separates.

issues.problem: The sky cyan is saturated near #6FD8F5, and the cloud comes close to pure white. Both are hotter than the muted sand and sage palette.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 3: no pure white, controlled saturation; §4.1 one hot accent 0.2
issues.fix: Lower sky saturation by about 10% toward #86CFE6 and tint the cloud warm to #F6F1E6.

issues.problem: The faceted agave leaves end in hard, needle-sharp points and crisp polygon edges. They are the one spiky silhouette in an otherwise soft, rounded form language.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 5: chunky, rounded silhouettes; §4.1 minor flaw 0.2
issues.fix: Round the leaf tips with a 2–3 px radius bevel, or make them blunter and wider by about 15%.

issues.problem: The high-contrast black and white stripes on the partridge at the bottom-left edge pull the eye away from the character focal point at the bottom right.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 6: one obvious focal point; §4.1 minor flaw 0.2
issues.fix: Lower the partridge's stripe contrast by about 20%, or move it 80 px inward and slightly behind the grass so it reads as secondary.

issues.problem: The character's rock and the partridge's feet both sit tight against the bottom frame edge, which makes awkward tangents with little breathing room.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 7: breathing room, no awkward tangents; §4.1 tangent 0.2
issues.fix: Tilt the camera down about 3° or raise the framing by about 40 px, so the rock and the bird clear the bottom edge.

issues.problem: The large sand areas are flat-shaded with almost no grain, so the ground reads a little plasticky next to the board's textured frames.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 10: materials read with subtle grain; §4.1 one soft texture 0.2
issues.fix: Add a low-contrast (3–4%) warm noise or speckle detail texture to the sand albedo.

issues.region: left grass tufts and gull wings, top-right
issues.problem: The thin grass blades and the gull wing tips show slight stair-step aliasing at 720p.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 18: no aliasing; §4.1 minor flaw 0.2
issues.fix: Turn on MSAA 4x or TAA, and widen the alpha-tested blades by 1 px with alpha-to-coverage.

issues.problem: The subject, the seated child, fills only about 12% of the frame height and sits among busy agave shapes, so at 720p JPEG it takes a moment longer to find than the board's clearest frames.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 2: a frame with no game state is judged on how instantly its subject reads at 720p
issues.fix: Push the camera in about 15% on the child, or lower the value of the agave behind the child by about 8% L so the character silhouette pops.

issues.problem: The sky is a hot, near-cyan blue (about #6FE0FA) that is noticeably more saturated than the warm ochre and sage palette around it.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 3: controlled saturation, harmonised hues
issues.fix: Shift the sky toward about #8CCFE8 (saturation down about 15%) and add a faint warm haze near the horizon.

issues.problem: Cast shadows on the sand are one flat, uniform tone with no falloff or ambient bounce, which flattens the slope's depth slightly.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 4: pieces lift off the ground; lighting that is clear but not flat
issues.fix: Add a soft 2–4 px penumbra to the shadows and a warm bounce tint (about +5% orange) in the shadowed sand.

issues.problem: The agave leaf tips are needle-sharp spikes, which sit at odds with the rounded child and the rounded cactus pads.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 5: chunky toy silhouettes, rounded edges
issues.fix: Blunt the leaf tips with a 1–2 vertex rounded cap, or widen the tip width by about 30%.

issues.problem: The large foreground agave is the biggest and highest-contrast mass in the frame, so it competes with the child for first fixation.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 6: one obvious focal point
issues.fix: Darken and desaturate the foreground agave by about 10%, or crop it down 60 px so the eye lands on the child first.

issues.problem: The partridge's feet and the wagtail both sit on the frame edge, creating small tangents at the bottom border.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 7: no awkward tangents
issues.fix: Move the partridge up about 30 px and the wagtail left about 40 px so both have at least 24 px of clearance from the edges.

issues.problem: The large rock slab is untextured flat colour with no grain, so it reads a little plasticky next to the board's textured surfaces.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 10: materials read with subtle grain
issues.fix: Add a subtle low-contrast grain or speckle (about 3% value variance) and a faint edge highlight on the rock faces.

issues.region: top-centre (cactus spines and seagulls against sky)
issues.problem: The thin cactus spines and the seagull wingtips show slight stair-step aliasing against the bright sky.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 18: no aliasing
issues.fix: Enable MSAA 4x or FXAA on the final pass, or thicken the sub-pixel spines to at least 1.5 px.

issues.region: frame border, all four sides outside the room
issues.problem: The flat purple checkerboard backdrop looks more like a generic editor or transparency pattern than part of the handcrafted pixel world inside the room.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 1: every element reads as one deliberate world; §4.1 reference-band minor flaw (0.1)
issues.fix: Swap the checker for a low-contrast tinted texture that matches the room's style (e.g. a dithered vignette in the same violet, with contrast around 1.1:1 between tiles).

issues.region: bottom-centre, the Rubik's cube and the cursor on the boombox
issues.problem: The small props and the hover cursor are only about 15–25 px tall, so at 720p stream compression the thing being interacted with is easy to miss.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 2: subject reads within 1 s at 720p; reference-band minor flaw (0.2)
issues.fix: Add a 2 px warm outline or highlight to the hovered object and scale the cursor up about 1.5x.

issues.region: centre, the red boombox against the blue-violet room
issues.problem: The saturated red boombox is the one hot accent that pulls away from the otherwise controlled blue, violet and tan palette.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 3: palette discipline; §4.1 'one hot accent' minor flaw (0.2)
issues.fix: Pull the boombox red down about 10% in saturation and shift it toward coral so it harmonises with the pink props.

issues.region: floor props: soccer ball (bottom-left), frog and cube (bottom-centre)
issues.problem: Contact shadows under the loose floor props are faint, so they sit on the carpet instead of lifting off it, and the lighting reads slightly flat.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 4: pieces lift off the surface via blob shadow; reference-band minor flaw (0.2)
issues.fix: Add a 1-tone darker, violet-tinted elliptical blob shadow under each floor prop at about 30% opacity.

issues.region: centre, the cardboard box flaps and corners
issues.problem: The box flaps and corners are hard-cornered wedges, a bit sharper than the rounded posts and toys around them.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 5: chunky, soft silhouettes; reference-band minor flaw (0.1)
issues.fix: Round off the flap tips with a 1–2 px corner shave so they match the bedpost caps.

issues.region: upper-right, the loft bed with its purple duvet and pink pig
issues.problem: The big purple bed block and the pink pig compete with the central box and boombox for first attention, which weakens the single focal point.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 6: one obvious focal point; reference-band minor flaw (0.2)
issues.fix: Lower the duvet's value contrast by about 8% or add a soft light pool to the centre boxes so the interaction target leads.

issues.region: top edge, the rear wall corner and bedpost near y=0
issues.problem: The top of the rear wall and the back bedpost touch or clip the top frame edge, a tangent, while the bottom has more margin.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 7: breathing room, no awkward tangents; §4.1 'a tangent' minor flaw (0.2)
issues.fix: Move the room down about 20 px or zoom out about 4% so there is an even margin above the wall top.

issues.region: left and right wall panels; carpet floor
issues.problem: The vertical wall-board lines repeat very evenly and the carpet is an almost flat fill, so these two surfaces have less material grain than the wood and cardboard.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 10: materials read, subtle grain, no visible regularity; reference-band minor flaw (0.2)
issues.fix: Vary the plank spacing and highlights by ±1 px, and add a sparse 2-tone dither to the carpet.

issues.region: whole frame, the backdrop and the top-edge crop
issues.problem: The generic checker backdrop and the tight top crop are the only things that stop a stranger reading this as a finished marketing capture.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 15: premium indie gut check; reference-band minor flaw (0.1)
issues.fix: Apply the fixes in CAL-R1-01 and CAL-R1-07 (a themed backdrop and an even top margin).

issues.region: pixel edges throughout, e.g. the bedposts and the soccer ball outline
issues.problem: The pixel edges look slightly soft, as though the art is scaled by a non-integer factor, which blurs some pixel-art lines.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 18: no scaling or aliasing artefacts; reference-band minor flaw (0.2)
issues.fix: Render at an integer scale (e.g. 4x) with nearest-neighbour filtering and letterbox any leftover space.

issues.problem: The interaction cursor over the boombox is small (~20 px) and dark-on-red, so at 720p JPEG it's hard to tell which item is being handled.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 2 (state clear within 1 s at stream quality); §4.1 reference band minor flaw
issues.fix: Scale the cursor to about 32 px with a 2 px light outline, and add a 1 px highlight rim to the hovered prop.

issues.problem: The pillow and curtains are close to pure white and are the brightest values in the frame. They pull against the harmonised blue-lilac palette.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 3 (no pure black or white); §4.1 one hot accent
issues.fix: Tint the whites toward the wall hue (about #EEF0FA) and drop the brightest highlights by roughly 5% value.

issues.region: floor under boxes, frog, ball and dresser
issues.problem: Contact shadows are faint or missing, so the loose props sit a little flat on the carpet.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 4 (pieces lift off the board through a shadow); §4.1 minor flaw
issues.fix: Add a 1–2 px dithered blob shadow in carpet-dark indigo under each floor prop, offset to match the light source.

issues.problem: The window suggests a light source, but it throws no light patch onto the floor or dresser, so the key direction reads weakly.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 4 (clear key light); §4.1 second-look minor flaw
issues.fix: Add a soft, low-opacity (about 10%) warm parallelogram of window light across the floor and dresser top.

issues.region: whole room, right shelf and bed
issues.problem: The central boxes are the focus, but the saturated shelf props and the purple bed compete with them at similar contrast, which slows the eye's route to the action.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 6 (one obvious focal point); §4.1 minor flaw
issues.fix: Desaturate the props that are already placed by about 10%, or give the boxes and the held item a subtle 1 px warm rim.

issues.problem: The top-right corner of the room is cropped by the frame, and the wall's top rail runs almost tangent to the top edge.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 7 (breathing room, no awkward tangents); §4.1 tangent
issues.fix: Zoom out about 6% or shift the camera down about 30 px so the whole room box fits with an even margin.

issues.problem: The front edge of the floor sits close to the bottom of the frame, while the margins at the top and sides are uneven.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 7 (breathing room); §4.1 minor flaw
issues.fix: Centre the room box vertically so the top and bottom margins are equal (about 24 px each).

issues.region: background outside the room, all four corners
issues.problem: The purple checkerboard backdrop is a plain, obviously repeating tile, which is weaker than the materials inside the room.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 10 (no visible tiling); §4.1 minor flaw
issues.fix: Replace the backdrop with a soft vignette gradient or a lower-contrast pattern (under 3% value difference).

issues.problem: The generic checker backdrop makes the frame feel a little like a template around an otherwise premium diorama.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 15 (a premium indie game, not a template); §4.1 minor flaw
issues.fix: Give the surround a bespoke treatment, such as a faint wallpaper motif or a radial vignette in the palette's darkest indigo.

issues.problem: The settings gear is a flat, plain-white vector glyph. It doesn't match the painted, textured tiles of the bottom toolbar, so it's the one element that looks like a stock UI overlay.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 1: world and UI read as one handcrafted style; §4.1 minor flaw 0.1
issues.fix: Put the gear on the same painted, bordered tile as the toolbar (about 36 px, same warm tint and inner shadow), or tint the glyph to the parchment tone at about 90% opacity with a soft drop shadow

issues.problem: The toolbar icons are only about 28–30 px at 720p, so their glyphs (brush, eraser, path) turn to mush under stream compression.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 2: state readable within 1 s at 720p; §4.1 minor flaw 0.2
issues.fix: Make the tiles about 40 px at 720p and simplify the glyphs to a thicker 2.5 px stroke

issues.problem: The white camera-rotate arrows sit over pale sunlit foliage and nearly disappear.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 2: text and icons read instantly at 720p; §4.1 minor flaw 0.1
issues.fix: Add a 2 px dark-green outline or a 30% dark backing pill behind the rotate arrows

issues.problem: The UI glyphs are close to pure white, while everything else uses a warm, tinted palette.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 3: no pure black or white; §4.1 minor flaw 0.1
issues.fix: Tint the glyphs to a warm cream (about #F4EEDC) instead of #FFFFFF

issues.problem: The sunlit canopy highlights come close to clipping, and the brightest foliage loses its leaf detail.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 4: clear key light without harshness; §4.1 minor flaw 0.1
issues.fix: Pull the highlight shoulder in the tonemapper down about 0.3 EV, or clamp foliage albedo to 85%

issues.problem: The large central rock is hard-faceted low-poly with sharp creases. Its crisper form language clashes with the soft rounded bricks and bushes and draws attention on a second look.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 5: every edge beveled or rounded; §4.1 minor flaw 0.2
issues.fix: Smooth the rock normals or add 2–4 cm bevels on its facets so its shading matches the rounded bricks

issues.problem: The heart-and-hand interaction cursor is small, and the dense, evenly bright flower scatter across the whole frame competes with it for attention.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 6: one obvious focal point; §4.1 minor flaw 0.1
issues.fix: Scale the heart about 1.3×, and add a slight vignette or reduce petal saturation about 15% toward the frame edges

issues.problem: The secondary ruin on the right is almost as bright and detailed as the hero ruin, which splits the eye.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 6: eye moves action → state → context; §4.1 minor flaw 0.1
issues.fix: Darken or defocus the right-hand ruin by about 10% exposure so the centre dominates

issues.problem: The toolbar sits right on top of the bright foreground bush and lupins at bottom-left, making a busy tangent where the flowers are cut by the frame edge.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 7: breathing room, no awkward tangents; §4.1 minor flaw 0.2
issues.fix: Raise the toolbar 12 px and place a subtle 40 px dark gradient scrim behind it, or tilt the camera 3° up to clear the foreground bush

issues.problem: The toolbar tiles show no clear selected state, and the gear and arrows don't share the tiles' border and radius treatment.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 9: visible states, consistent radii and icon weight; §4.1 minor flaw 0.2
issues.fix: Give the active tool a 2 px warm outline and 4 px lift, and put the gear and arrows on the same 6 px-radius tile style

issues.problem: The boulder has flat per-facet shading with almost no grain, so it reads less like a material than the textured bricks and grass do.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 10: surfaces read as materials with subtle grain; §4.1 minor flaw 0.2
issues.fix: Add a low-contrast painted stone detail texture (about 8% strength) and some moss on the upward-facing facets

issues.problem: Several tool tiles are told apart mainly by background tint (orange, green, blue), and their small glyphs have little contrast against those tints.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 11: colour + glyph identity, contrast ≥ 4.5:1 in principle; §4.1 minor flaw 0.1
issues.fix: Darken the glyphs to a deep brown (#3A2A1E) to get ≥ 4.5:1 on every tile tint, and make the glyph silhouettes more distinct

issues.problem: The white arrows over light foliage fall well below 3:1 contrast in places.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 11: contrast ≥ 4.5:1 in principle; §4.1 minor flaw 0.2
issues.fix: Add a dark 2 px outline or a 35% opacity backing disc

issues.problem: The one generic-looking UI glyph slightly undercuts an otherwise premium frame.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 15: stranger believes premium indie; §4.1 minor flaw 0.1
issues.fix: Restyle the gear to match the painted toolbar tiles (see CAL-R1-01)

issues.region: bottom-left and bottom-right grass and flower edges
issues.problem: Fine grass blades and petal edges show slight aliasing and sparkle against the dark ground.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 18: no aliasing shimmer; §4.1 minor flaw 0.2
issues.fix: Enable TAA or alpha-to-coverage on the foliage cards, and add a 0.5 px mip bias on the grass alpha

issues.problem: The hard-faceted low-poly rocks sit next to soft painterly foliage and rounded block masonry. They read as a slightly different modelling language from the rest of the scene.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 1: one cohesive art direction
issues.fix: Add a 2–3 px edge bevel to the rock facets and blend the moss/grass texture onto their top faces so they match the softness of the masonry

issues.region: top-right gear icon and top-centre rotate arrows
issues.problem: The flat white system glyphs float on the scene with no tile, so they don't match the illustrated toolbar tiles along the bottom edge.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 1: UI matches world
issues.fix: Place the gear and rotate glyphs on the same parchment tile style the toolbar uses (radius 8 px, warm cream fill)

issues.problem: The toolbar icons are about 36 px at 720p, and the pale glyphs (sun, rock, image) lose definition at stream compression.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 2: instant legibility at 720p
